_help: Plate-check findings accepted on purpose. An entry matches the same plate and kind ('wall', 'near-miss', 'fit', 'floor', 'preferred', 'insert', 'grid' or 'layer') within 1 mm of x/y and 0.05 mm of value (the wall thickness or hole diameter). If the geometry changes, the finding is reported again.
